features: Easy Connectivity: Connect to multiple devices effortlessly. The OBAGE Essential 6 speaker system features HDMI ARC, Bluetooth, USB and RCA inputs, allowing you to easily connect to your computer, TV, gaming console, or smartphone. Enjoy hassle-free switching between different audio sources.

Convenient Controls: Stay in command of your audio experience with the integrated controls. Adjust Volume, Treble and Bass levels directly from the remote control putting the power to fine-tune your audio right at your fingertips.
Onsite service support: Get your product serviced at an ease of sitting at home.

Compact and Versatile Design: Designed to fit seamlessly into any space, the OBAGE Essential 6 speaker system is compact yet powerful. The satellite speakers can be conveniently placed on your desk or mounted on walls, while the subwoofer provides room-filling bass without taking up too much space.
